term.label: epigenomically_modified_region

definition.text: A biological region implicated in inherited changes caused by mechanisms other than changes in the underlying DNA sequence.

comments: Added as part of GREEKC terms to differentiate between inherited and not inherited epigenetic changes. See GitHub Issue #532.

firstSeen.subject: Added new term epigenomically_modified_region (SO:0002332) and updated definition of epigenetically_modified_region (SO:0001720) to have epigenomically include inherited changes while epigenetically does not. See GitHub Issue #532.
